annotations.title: Forward a question to a business

description: Queue an unanswered question without sign-in; returns status and message. Call only after ask_business returns answered: false and the shopper approves the exact question and business; set consent: true then. Contact sharing requires a separate explicit choice; omit name/email otherwise. Questions containing phone numbers, emails or links are refused. Daily limits: three per caller, one per caller/business pair and eight per business across callers. This call sends nothing; eventual forwarding is at most weekly per business and replies are not guaranteed. Suggest direct contact and never say the business has been contacted.
name: forward_question
title: Forward a question to a business
